## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 23, 2026 - Sep 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _9host_girl_, Sep 26, 2026, 1/5: "Now I won’t have any extra money for my birthday. It could take a while for the refund request to Apple to go through, so it most likely won’t be solved in time, as my birthday is tomorrow. Very sad and deleting the app now. I was using it to help me gain weight and track my calories, since I’ve been stressed and lost weight. I’ve had this app for a long time, and used it in the past to maintain weight, but this experience has ruined it for me honestly. It’s just too high of a charge for forgetting to cancel a free trial & not worth all this extra stress"
            2. _lovelyorangelady_, Sep 23, 2026, 3/5: "I have been an avid user of this app for the past couple of years. I will say the interface is easy to use, but within the last few months there have been features that were originally free now hidden behind a paywall. this is absolutely ridiculous that I cannot set my own macro goals and that they HAVE to be on a set amount. I understand that some features need to be paid for, but this is just made me not want to use the app. Absolutely ridiculous."
            3. _Jelly_fishy_, Sep 24, 2026, 5/5: "So this app is very helpful,but I don’t like how you have to pay premium in order to track your protein consumption. I get it, This is what it takes to keep the app free,but at least let me log what I need too."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      4 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Sep 25, 2026 - Sep 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Dog19827_, Sep 26, 2026, 1/5: "When I am trying to log food there is a delay for me to enter or I have to back out and go in to add food. I believe it started happening when the small ads appeared. Never noticed before. Very annoying."
            2. _89rr_, Sep 25, 2026, 1/5: "The constant ads and the shift of basic features into the premium package ensures you won’t use the free version. So if you do t want to spend the $80 a year, use another app (Cronometer) they took away barcode scanning for logging and every 3 seconds there is a pop up. It increases my blood pressure whenever I open the app. Their strategy works though I’m spending the $80."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Sep 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kaspar Lee_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "Literally a million settings and no setting for this, always getting random notifications at random times to try and get me back on the app, zero setting to turn off. Also app is quite buggy and over complicated."
            2. _IXE_04_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The app used to be way better. The UI is confusing, jumbled, and overall just horrible compared to the old one not to mention it glitches and lags way more now. figure it out!"
            3. _RuachOo_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "The app has become so bloated over the years its extremely slow, and the unnecessary praising and popups is super annoying. Less clicks = better experience. It also often just freezes for 10seconds before responding again when i open the app"
<!--/ir-theme-->
